title: Nigeria national evidence snapshots

observations.sourcePublisher: WHO Regional Office for Africa · Global Health Observatory

observations.geographicCoverage: Dashboard reports coverage across 36 states, FCT and 774 LGAs

reconciliationNotes.title: BudgIT H1 2026 health total discrepancy
reconciliationNotes.detail: The executive summary and Tables 1 and 5 report ₦621.34bn; a narrative paragraph on page 7 reports ₦624.53bn. Do not silently choose or reconcile the difference.

reconciliationNotes.title: BudgIT PHC total discrepancy
reconciliationNotes.detail: Table 1 reports ₦61.08bn PHC expenditure in H1 2026, while pages 17–18 report ₦61.21bn. Do not use either as a settled aggregate until checked against state BIRs.

reconciliationNotes.title: Four state health expenditure values flagged
reconciliationNotes.detail: BudgIT Table 5 marks Sokoto, Kogi, Imo and Cross River because numeric calculations differ from the underlying Q1/Q2 Budget Implementation Reports.

reconciliationNotes.title: Two states missing H1 2026 health expenditure data
reconciliationNotes.detail: Rivers and Osun are absent from BudgIT's 34-state dataset. Their values are unknown, not zero.

reconciliationNotes.title: BudgIT top-five concentration share needs reconciliation
reconciliationNotes.detail: The report states the top five states account for 45.19% of health expenditure. Their Table 2 amounts sum to ₦282.23bn; divided by the Table 1/5 total of ₦621.34bn this is about 45.43%. The published 45.19% aligns more closely with the conflicting ₦624.53bn narrative total. Do not repeat the 45.19% share without reconciling the denominator.
